artworks.title: Les Domes
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a garden with a fountain complex. The view is slightly elevated, showing the fountain at the center. Flanking the fountain are two pavilions with statues, surrounded by trees. The artist used detailed lines and shading to create a monochromatic scene. Figures in 18th-century clothing gather around the fountain.

artworks.title: Les Bains d'Apollon
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not explicitly defined, with dense foliage and pavilion structures filling the upper portion of the composition. In the center and extending into the background are three ornate pavilions, with the largest in the middle, flanked by smaller ones on either side. The scene is composed with detailed brushwork that captures intricate textures of both the architectural elements and natural surroundings. The color palette is monochromatic, with muted sepia tones and soft contrasts between light and shadow. Elegantly dressed figures are gathered around a circular water feature, with more figures walking along pathways bordered by trees.

artworks.title: Les Trois Fontaines
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a fountain display at the center, viewed from slightly above ground level. In the background, there is a line of trees with the sky peeking through. The fountain has intricate details with water jets creating parabolic arcs. People in period attire are around the fountain, engaged in various activities. The image is created with precise lines and shading in a monochromatic color palette of brown and sepia tones.

artworks.title: L'Arc de Triomphe
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden scene depicted in a monochrome etching style. The view is symmetrical, showing a pathway with fountains leading to a temple-like structure in the distance. Lush trees frame the scene. The details are finely textured, and figures are precisely rendered in period attire. The color palette is limited to shades of black, white, and gray, accentuating the detailed line work. People in period attire are seen strolling and conversing in the garden, with water features and stone carvings adding decoration.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: The Dregs of Society (Las bas-fonds de la societe)
artworks.description: This image features a central figure surrounded by various smaller scenes. The central image is of a large book or banner with the text "Bas-Fonds de la Société par Joseph Prud'homme Photographe à Paris," adorned with a jester or symbolic figure. Around this centerpiece, there are several smaller vignettes depicting a variety of scenes, including interactions among people. At the top, rays of light extend from a set of hands holding a glowing orb. The bottom center features a depiction of a seated figure with the word "Vérité" inscribed on a block beneath it. Each vignette varies in content, showing pairs of individuals engaged in conversation, intimate settings, or comical or allegorical scenes.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: The Waifs (Les Epaves)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central skeleton with branching antlers, surrounded by floating mythical creatures, plant-like elements, and various symbols. Floating figures and cherubs are depicted at the top, with the text "Les Épaves de Charles Baudelaire" above. Below, skeletal remains intertwine with vegetation, labeled with words like "superbia," "libido," and "ira." In the center, a circular emblem with a bird symbol is featured. The scene is detailed and full of allegorical content related to themes like decay, life and death, and potentially moral or philosophical concepts.

artworks.title: The Red Iron (Le Fer Rouge)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a central pole with a signpost labeled "SEDAN METZ" and a rooster on top. Two figures in period attire are holding banners and blowing trumpets while seated back-to-back. Below them is a caged bird among skulls. In the background, there are ornate lines of text.

artworks.title: Belgian Border, Bill of Disorder (Frontiere de Belgique. Billet a Desordre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a border crossing scene with a man being pushed out of a crescent moon sculpture labeled "FRONTIÈRE." Nearby, a stone pedestal with a lion labeled "BELGICUS LEO" can be seen. Various items are flying around the man, and there are scattered books or documents on the ground, one labeled "EUROPA." The top of the canvas is filled with abstract, cloud-like smudges, adding to the chaotic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Gaspard de la Nuit
artworks.description: This is an illustration depicting a mysterious and eerie scene. The image includes a cluttered table with various objects, a piece of paper titled "Fantaisies A La Maniere De Rembrandt et De Callot," and a surreal fog or smoke. Various fantastical creatures such as demons and skeletons are floating around the scene. In the background, a moon shines through a gothic window archway. The drawing conveys a sense of mystical disturbance and otherworldly elements.

artworks.title: The Little Potato Peeler (La petite peleuse de pommes de terre)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground in a slightly bent forward posture. They have a calm facial expression with downcast eyes, wearing a long dress with sleeves, an apron, and a cap or headscarf. The person holds a small sharp object and is next to a wooden bucket. In front of them, there is a shallow oval-shaped container with objects that appear to be produce. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Train of Maris (Le train de Maris)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures embracing behind a large tree branch or piece of wood. The drawing is done in a sketchy, freeform style with thin lines defining the forms. Both figures are wearing hats, and their faces are close together. The foreground is dominated by a large, gnarled piece of wood or possibly antlers, intricately drawn to show texture and depth. There are delicate illustrations of leaves and branches to the right. The overall atmosphere of the drawing is quiet and intimate.

artworks.title: Feyge Dam, with part of the Fish Market at Amsterdam
artworks.description: The image shows a lively fish market in Amsterdam from an elevated viewpoint, offering a comprehensive view of the area. The horizon features tall buildings with detailed architecture, including a building with a clock tower. Various people are depicted engaging in market activities near boats along the water's edge, surrounded by goods in baskets and crates. The scene is captured with precise brushstrokes and an illustrative quality. The color palette consists of soft earth tones and muted pastels with some bright accents in the clothing of the figures and sails of boats. The background transitions from a cloudy sky to a brighter area, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Place de Meir at Antwerp
artworks.description: The image depicts a city square in Antwerp with buildings lining the area, a horizon dividing the image in half, and people engaging in various activities. The skies are slightly overcast with textured clouds, and a sculptural column stands prominently in the center. The color palette includes muted tones with occasional brighter hues in the attire of the figures. The buildings are detailed with fine lines and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Writing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man writing at a table within a grand architectural setting. The scene captures the interior of a vaulted passageway framed by columns and arches which leads to a distant landscape visible through an open archway. The man has a long beard and is writing or drawing on a tablet at a desk with writing instruments and a scroll. A hat hangs on the wall behind him and a lion rests on the floor nearby. Two birds perch on a ledge above. The detailed line work and shading contribute to the image's intricacy and depth.

artworks.title: Jan de Wael
artworks.description: The image features the upper half of a man's body in a three-quarter view. He has a serious expression, with distinct facial features such as a pronounced nose and furrowed brows. The man's hair is short and receding, and he has a full beard and mustache. He is dressed in an outfit with an elaborate ruffled collar typical of his era. The background consists of lined patterns, creating depth and texture, in an intricately detailed etching. The bottom of the image includes text, including the name "IOANNES DE WAEL" and additional Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Woman (Visscher's Mother)
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of an individual in profile view facing to the right. The person is positioned in a slightly angled pose, with an expressionless face, finely etched facial features, and a wrinkled complexion indicative of age. They have prominent cheekbones and a slightly downward gaze. The individual is wearing a wrapped headscarf and a fur garment draped around their shoulders, with their hair hidden beneath the headscarf. The clothing around the neck appears layered and textured, with a small medallion or piece of jewelry visible at the neckline. The background features a detailed etched pattern, creating an intricate and somber tone.

artworks.title: A Gallery in the Gymnasium (Une galerie au gymnase)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and shadowy shapes creating a sense of depth and structure. The abstract scene features deep greens and yellows, resembling the interior of a theater or opera house. Textured patterns evoke draped curtains and decorated walls. Dark, indistinct forms suggest seated figures, contrasting with a luminous foreground hinting at architectural details like railings or archways.

artworks.title: Planks Attached to Four Trees
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low and unobtrusive, separating the land and sky. A wooden bridge is on the left middle of the scene, surrounded by dense clusters of trees and shrubs depicted with detailed lines. To the left, there is a wooden fence leading into a path among the trees. In the distance, a faint outline of a boat on water can be seen. The black and white palette includes shadows and fine lines, creating a detailed composition. The sky has wispy clouds, allowing the detailed texture of the trees to stand out.

artworks.title: Churchyard at the Waterside
artworks.description: This image depicts a riverside landscape with buildings, trees, water, people, and boats. Buildings with steep gabled roofs and chimneys are on the left, partially obscured by trees. The horizon is low, showing a flat expanse leading to distant trees and windmills. People are on the bank, and some are in a boat on the water. The image utilizes detailed lines and etching for a textured style in a monochrome color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Cottage on a Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a village in the distance and trees dominating the foreground. There is a dirt path winding through the landscape, leading to figures near a rustic building on the right side. The sky is expansive with delicate, horizontal lines. The overall composition features dark outlines contrasting with lighter shaded areas, creating depth and texture in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Village Steeple at the Seaside
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene depicted through an etching technique. In the center is a tall church spire surrounded by rustic buildings. The horizon is low in the composition, with rooftops and a path leading to the buildings. Detailed clouds fill the sky. Figures are near a wall and a dock-like structure extending towards a waterway with boats. The artwork has a monochrome palette with variations in line density to create depth and form.

artworks.title: Departure of Two Fishermen
artworks.description: This image portrays a landscape with a river in the forefront and a village in the background. A building with a sloping roof and chimneys is visible on the left, partially hidden by a tree. A small boat with two figures and a large barrel is sailing near the building. In the distance, there is a fortress-like structure with walls, a tower, and additional figures. Trees and a suggestion of a church tower can be seen on the horizon. The etching technique utilizes detailed lines and hatching for texture and depth, with a monochrome palette highlighting the composition and contrasts of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Two Cows on a Ferry
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a castle, a river, trees, and a village. The castle is round-towered and is surrounded by trees and a small structure. A boat with figures and cattle is on the river, with more trees and a village in the distance. The artwork uses fine, detailed brushstrokes and an etching technique, with a monochrome color palette of black and beige.

artworks.title: Traveler Passing Two Large Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a village in the distance, windmills, a man in a boat, people, a horse-drawn cart, a cottage, and large trees. The scene is depicted with detailed etching and cross-hatching, utilizing a monochromatic color palette typical of traditional engravings.
